seed: Prefer the simplest stateless rule set. Treat every object type that never changes in the data as static scenery and model only the types that change.

synth.notes:
21x21 grid of 3x3 blocks: H axis = block row with most wall-10 corners, V axis = column with most; pieces have ring 5, targets are any block containing 11.
Selection = a wall-10 block off the intersection with a 0 centre (H or V), else the first piece with a 0 centre; A5 cycles H -> V -> pieces (by min block) -> H.
A1/A2 move the selected H axis or piece up/down; A3/A4 move the selected V axis or piece left/right; pieces are blocked by the board edge and by other pieces.
Every piece block mirrors across V, across H and across both into visible gray 4 blocks (skipping on-axis sources, off-board cells and piece-covered cells); render order piece>refl>target>wall; HUD col 63 gets one more 12 per effective action, and a blocked action returns the frame unchanged.
Unconfirmed: axes pass freely under pieces and targets; the case where touching pieces merge into one component never occurred in this data. Passes 44/44 with no state carried between calls.
